textos.As discussões se concentram na estrutura: The discussions center on the narrative structure and diverge on the effectiveness of the plot's twists. While nearly all of those who disapprove consider the revelations predictable and frustrating, most of those who recommend it positively highlight the twists and the mysteries solved over the course of the story.
textos.Várias reviews descrevem o filme como le: Several reviews describe the film as slow, dragging and boring, with difficulty holding interest throughout the screening.
textos.Muitas pessoas afirmam que a reviravolta: Many people say the final twist is obvious and easy to predict, taking away the narrative's impact.
textos.Falta de contexto político e covardia: Lack of political context and cowardice
textos.Algumas críticas apontam que o filme evi: Some criticisms point out that the film avoids political positions and opts for an aseptic approach, not exploring the real conflict.
textos.Atuações fracas e falta de credibilidade: Weak performances and lack of credibility
textos.Há reclamações sobre atuações pouco conv: There are complaints about unconvincing performances and a lack of emotional connection with the characters.
textos.Algumas reviews consideram o filme sensa: Some reviews consider the film sensationalist and exploitative, using themes such as incest and violence gratuitously.
textos.Críticas mencionam incoerências na trama: Criticisms mention inconsistencies in the plot, questionable character decisions and artificial dialogue.
textos.Reviravolta previsível ou que não surpre: Twist that is predictable or did not surprise
textos.Vários espectadores relataram ter anteci: Several viewers reported having anticipated the main twist as early as the middle of the film, which reduced the emotional impact and the surprise they expected to feel.
textos.A narrativa foi percebida como vagarosa: The narrative was perceived as sluggish by a good portion of the group, with stretches that felt long and not very engaging, making the experience tiring.
textos.Mesmo entre os que não gostaram do conju: Even among those who did not like the whole, many highlighted the direction and the strength of the performances as high points of the film.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas consideraram qu: Some middling reviews considered that the plot forces extreme situations just to provoke suffering in the audience, sounding artificial or manipulative.
textos.Fotografia e aspectos técnicos bem avali: Cinematography and technical aspects well rated
textos.A qualidade da fotografia e o cuidado té: The quality of the cinematography and the technical care were cited as undeniable strengths, despite reservations about the story.
textos.Parte do grupo sentiu falta de aprofunda: A portion of the group missed greater depth in the characters, who seemed to function only as pieces to move the mystery along, hindering emotional engagement.
textos.Muitos espectadores descrevem a experiên: Many viewers describe the experience as emotionally shattering, comparing it to a punch in the stomach or a carefully planned psychological assault, and report that the film stays in the mind for days.
textos.A reviravolta é frequentemente citada co: The twist is often cited as shocking and brutal, even by those who say they predicted the outcome; some consider it unnecessary, but most describe it as a blow that reconfigures the whole narrative.
textos.Villeneuve é elogiado por sua habilidade: Villeneuve is praised for his skill in building tension and driving the story, with this film pointed out by several as one of his masterpieces or a landmark in his filmography.
textos.A performance da atriz principal é desta: The lead actress's performance is highlighted as phenomenal and moving, with her facial expression in one specific scene described as terrifying and unforgettable.
textos.A cinematografia é elogiada por capturar: The cinematography is praised for capturing the aridity and vastness of the Middle East realistically and without Orientalist filters, contributing to the oppressive, melancholic atmosphere.
textos.A estrutura fragmentada e os saltos temp: The fragmented structure and the time jumps are seen as effective devices for building the mystery and connecting past and present, although some consider the third act less cohesive.

textos.Lançado em 2010 e dirigido por Denis Vil: Released in 2010 and directed by Denis Villeneuve, Incendies is a drama with elements of mystery and war that follows the twins Simon and Jeanne. After their mother's death, the two discover that their father is alive and that they have an unknown brother, setting off on a search that brings revelations about themselves.
textos.A narrativa é construída com uma cadênci: The narrative is built with a calculated, gradual cadence, structured around the slow unfolding of family secrets. The atmosphere rests on a sober tone and on the continuous progression of the investigation carried out by the protagonists.
textos.Os diferentes grupos avaliados concentra: The different groups evaluated focus on the same elements and disagree on the verdict about the work, not on the subjects discussed. In the vast majority of ratings (~94%), most highlight the devastating emotional impact generated by the narrative. Close to half stress the strength of the twist and the revelations, while a significant share value Denis Villeneuve's direction.
textos.Numa fração mínima das notas (~5%), para: In a minimal fraction of the ratings (~5%), for those who take a middle-ground reading, many point to the twist as predictable or not very surprising. In this group, a good portion also mention the slow pace and dragging moments, although a considerable number praise the direction and the performances.
textos.Por fim, numa fração ainda menor das not: Finally, in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), from a strictly negative perspective, several point to the slow pace and boredom throughout the film. In addition, many consider the twist predictable and disappointing, and a portion of them criticize the lack of political context in the handling of the plot.
